question: Does the natural material bundle leave repeatable ERB-scale time-frequency or spectral-tail structure when geometry, contact position, pickup and render recipe are fixed?

decision.rationale: Across 36 native/median pairs, full ERB-time cosine is 0.999601 median (0.995097 minimum); integrated and late-tail medians are 0.999992 and 0.999994. The observed low/high controls retain 0.999524–0.999944 integrated and 0.999394–0.999873 late-tail similarity, while full time-frequency similarity varies from 0.977845 to 0.995030 across only three geometries. Native/median material-effect map correlations across contact positions center near zero, and the same-coordinate position-identity distances are much larger. Broad ERB spectral-tail structure therefore remains nearly preserved under this recipe; this does not mean material has no physical effect or establish audibility.

implementationFacts: Reanalyzed only existing frozen native, material-median, material-low, and material-high fixed-gain stereo PCM files.

For each matched row, the frozen renderer replaced only the Plate material object; geometry, topology, contact schedule/position/strength/footprint, pickups, solver/rate, pulse, recovery, and damping semantics were retained.
The observed natural stiffness and damping vary together. Every result refers to the observed material bundle, not stiffness or damping alone.

materials.attributionBoundary: Stiffness and damping are coupled in the observed corpus; no isolated coefficient effect is claimed.

representation.source: existing fixed-gain stereo PCM; no rerender
representation.binBoundaryRule: equal ERB-rate edges on [0, 8000] Hz; half-open [low, high); FFT bin centers assigned by searchsorted(side=right); DC is in band 0
representation.oneSidedPower: |rFFT|^2/sum(Hann)^2; double included positive-frequency bins, leave DC undoubled; sum linear bin power within each ERB band before dB
representation.stereoPooling: arithmetic mean of left/right linear band power at each time frame

nativeFixedGain.absoluteScaleNote: Existing helper scale is descriptive for paired comparisons, not Parseval-calibrated broadband energy.

shapeOnly.use: diagnostic only; separate from native fixed-gain level evidence
shapeOnly.full: unit-sum each response's pooled 279x30 linear power, then flattened cosine
shapeOnly.integrated: sum pooled linear power over time per band, unit-sum each 30-band profile, then cosine
shapeOnly.late: same as integrated after left-aligned frame start >=0.5 s (185 frames), then unit-sum and cosine

difference.bandProfile: sum linear power over selected time window per band, then convert native/median ratio to dB
difference.earlyWindow: left-aligned frame starts from strike frame through <100 ms after strike
difference.lateWindow: left-aligned frame starts >=500 ms from output start, matching position-identity pass

positionChangeReference.materialVsPositionComparison: Descriptive 1-cosine distributions in the same normalized ERB coordinate space; not a formal variance decomposition or causal percentage.

interpretationBoundary.implementationFact: The existing renderer changed only Plate material object within each matched pair.
interpretationBoundary.measurement: Fixed-gain RMS/peak and unnormalized ERB power are separate from unit-sum shape similarities and signed difference-map correlations.
interpretationBoundary.researchInterpretation: Addresses broad ERB-band response of the observed natural material bundle under this frozen isolated render recipe.

nativeMedianDifferenceGrid.scaleMethod: global 99.5th percentile of absolute full-map dB ratios across all 36 primary pairs
